item.title: To cut the £3.6bn negligence bill, we must price risk before we price failure
item.description: Agreement: I AgreeBody: Dear Editor The Public Accounts Committee’s warning that clinical negligence costs have risen to around £3.6bn a year should not be read only as a legal or accounting problem. It signals a systems failure: we are willing to pay an unlimited price for failure, yet repeatedly refuse to price risk upfront [1]. item.title: The importance of statistical reasoning in vaccination-related legal disputes
item.description: Agreement: I AgreeBody: Dear Editor The recently published BMJ article highlights the critical role of robust statistical reasoning in medical misconduct cases and the serious consequences of its misuse in legal settings (1). item.title: Correcting the root cause of metabolic disease
item.description: Agreement: I AgreeBody: Dear Editor This research highlights the fact that obesity, and concurrent metabolic dysregulation, is not corrected by simply addressing a symptom. Upregulation of GLP-1 in order to overcome a deficiency without addressing the cause of that deficiency, relegates these drugs as chronic treatment of symptomology, much like cytokine blockade in autoimmune disease. item.title: Re: Iran: Doctor faces execution for treating protestors as nine other physicians arrested, human right groups warn
item.description: Agreement: I AgreeBody: Dear Editor, We write to express our grave concern regarding the escalating and systematic violations of medical neutrality in Iran. Credible and independent reports indicate that doctors, nurses, and other healthcare workers have been arrested, tortured, threatened with execution, and otherwise persecuted solely for providing medical care to civilians injured during recent nationwide protests. item.title: Re: Right C7 neurotomy at the intervertebral foramen plus intensive speech and language therapy versus intensive speech and language therapy alone for chronic post-stroke aphasia: multicentre, randomised controlled trial
item.description: Agreement: I AgreeBody: Dear Editor, Many thanks to Dr. Bishop for noticing that this paper does not currently have a working link to a repository where the data underlying the analyses can be accessed. We are aware of this problem and are working with the authors of the paper to correct the problem. We anticipate that a link to the data will soon be available in a corrected version of the paper. item.title: Prevention and inequalities: welcome golden threads in England’s National Cancer Plan, but delivery will be decisive
item.description: Agreement: I AgreeBody: Dear Editor Thanks for your coverage (1) of the England’s 10-year National Cancer Plan which sets out a bold ambition to improve cancer survival and save lives.
